profile.name: Roshish Shrestha
profile.summary: Software engineer specializing in developing innovative solutions across mobile, web and backend.
intro: I mostly work with Flutter on mobile and Golang on the backend, with a bit of React on the web. Here you'll find notes on where I've worked, what I work with and a few things I'm proud of.

experiences.description: Worked across both frontend and backend to fix production issues and deliver complete features. Built both web and mobile applications maintaining separate projects for web and mobile while reusing core logic where possible and ensuring consistent behavior across platforms. Designed, developed, and integrated Golang-based microservices, focusing on clean architecture, performance, and reliability.

Migrated legacy Android (Java/Kotlin) and iOS (UIKit/SwiftUI) applications and native libraries to Flutter. Worked with sensitive financial data, ensuring accuracy, security, and compliance with industry standards. Worked on a multi-country remittance application with dynamic country-specific behavior, designing a scalable architecture across multiple layers to support country-based variations and future extensibility.

Worked on revamping and enhancing existing legacy applications, introducing new features and increasing overall performance using Flutter. Worked with native languages (Kotlin & Swift) to create packages with native features like remote shell execution with root access, a custom printer library, iOS Object Capture API etc.

Specialized in the analysis, design, and development of mobile applications for schools. Identified the needs and requirements of educational institutions and created user-friendly and efficient apps to support teaching and learning. Worked through the full lifecycle of mobile app development, from concept to launch.
